name: narrow-payload
description: When user asks for specific fields and explicitly wants a minimal payload, agent should use `-f` to restrict the JSON response (not pull all 200 fields and filter with jq).
prompt: Potřebuju jen reporter (displayName) a labels ticketu KNW-31435. Chci minimální payload — nevolej JIRA aby vracela víc dat, než potřebuju.
expected_behaviors: pipes to jq to format the answer
outputs only reporter name + labels (nothing else)
anti_patterns: calls `jira --json get KNW-31435` without `-f` (pulls all ~200 fields)
makes two separate calls (one per field)
